999008199.text:
教えてください、ケイウンに今
何が起こっているんですか？

localizations.en: Please go on. What's the situation in Keiun right now?

999008199.text: ……我が主が反乱を起こそうとしているのでございます

localizations.en: ...My lord is attempting to incite a rebellion.

999008199.text: ちょっと待って、主が反乱って……

localizations.en: Wait a minute, your lord is planning a rebellion...?

999008199.text:
ケイウンの南部を治める堂免家で
３年前に当主になった鏑矢

localizations.en: My childhood friend and Kimon's master, Kaburaya, became head of the Doumen family that rules southern Keiun three years ago...

999008199.text:
俺の幼馴染にして、鬼門の仕えている主。
彼女が突如、乱心したんだ

localizations.en: Fast forward to today, she's acting erratically all of a sudden.

999008199.text: 堂免家の鏑矢さん、ですか……

彼女はまだ若いが、その武勇はすでに
ケイウン中に轟いている

localizations.en: She may still be young, but her martial prowess already echoes throughout Keiun.

999008199.text:
若干、破天荒なところはあるが、俺や鬼門、そして
巫女の千歳が補佐して盛り立てていくはずだった

localizations.en: She can be a bit reckless, but Kimon, the shrine maiden Chitose, and I were supposed to support and guide her.

999008199.text:
まさか俺が修行で国元を離れている間に
奸臣が取り入っていようとは……

localizations.en: I never imagined that while I was away training, a corrupt minister would worm his way into her confidence...

999008199.text: 奸臣ですか。物語であれば悪の大臣は定番ですが

localizations.en: A corrupt minister? My my, evil advisors are quite the classic trope in many novels.

999008199.text:
まさにそれでございまする。
陰陽師のコウセンをそばに置くようになってから

localizations.en: Precisely so. Ever since she began keeping the diviner Kosen at her side...

999008199.text:
軍備を増強し、苛烈な練兵を行い……
今にも戦を始めんばかりの御様子……

localizations.en: She has been strengthening her military forces and conducting brutal training exercises... It appears she's on the verge of starting a war...

999008199.text:
平和のぬるま湯に浸かり腑抜けたケイウンを憂え
今一度猛々しい武士の世を取り戻すと息巻いている

localizations.en: She laments that Keiun has grown soft and complacent in peaceful times, and she's determined to restore the fierce age of the samurai.

999008199.text: か、かなり過激な思想をお持ちですね

localizations.en: Th-that's a radical way of thinking...

999008199.text:
それだけじゃない。ケイウン全土を掌中に収めたならば
次は他の島々へと攻め込み、その覇を轟かせるつもりだ

localizations.en: That's not all. Once she has all of Keiun under her control, she plans to invade the other islands and spread her dominion.

999008199.text: でも、島同士が争うことは禁じられているんじゃ……

localizations.en: But isn't warfare between islands forbidden...?

999008199.text:
諸島同盟内ではそうだけどね。
ケイウンは同盟に所属してないから……

localizations.en: That's true within the Archipelago Federation, but Keiun isn't part of the alliance...

999008199.text:
たとえ掟があっても、抑止力にはなりませぬ。
恐らく諸島をも巻き込んだ大きな戦になりましょう

localizations.en: Even if such laws exist, they provide no deterrent. This will likely become a great war engulfing the entire island chain.

999008199.text:
民の望みは争いではなく、長久の平和に決まっている。
そう説得したんだけど、もはや聞く耳持たずでね……

localizations.en: The people's desire is for lasting peace, not conflict. I tried to persuade her of this, but she no longer listens...

999008199.text:
その鏑矢さんってのは
他人の忠告も聞けなくなってるのね……

localizations.en: So this Kaburaya has reached the point where she won't heed anyone's counsel...

999008199.text:
まあ元からわりと聞かん坊ではあるんだが。
さすがに俺や鬼門の話を無視はおかしい

localizations.en: Well, she was always pretty stubborn to begin with. But it's strange for her to completely ignore what Kimon and I have to say.

999008199.text:
俺が堂免領を離れている間の話を鬼門から聞き
陰陽師のコウセンが裏で糸を引いていると判断したのさ

localizations.en: After hearing from Kimon what happened while I was away from Doumen territory, I concluded that the diviner Kosen is pulling the strings behind the scenes.

999008199.text:
コウセンはなんらかの方法……恐らく陰陽術で
鏑矢の思考を凶暴化、好戦的にさせている

localizations.en: Kosen is using some method—likely onmyoji arts—to make Kaburaya more violent and aggressive in her thinking.

999008199.text:
我が主、鏑矢様を元に戻すため
錬金術士アルビーナ殿のお力添えを願いたく存じまする

localizations.en: To restore Lady Kaburaya to her former self, we humbly request your assistance.

999008199.text: なるほど、そういう事情だったんですね

localizations.en: I see, so that's the situation.

999008199.text:
快諾いただきたいが、急に言われてもまぁ困るよなぁ。
熟考のため、何か疑問があるようならば、なんなりと

localizations.en: I'd love for you to take on our request right away, but I know it's a lot to ask out of the blue. Take your time to ponder over it over, and feel free to ask any questions you might have.

999008199.text: じゃあ、質問いい？
どうぞ、お嬢さん

さっきから気になってたんだけど……
オンミョージとかオンミョージュツって、なに？

localizations.en: I've been wondering about this... What exactly are diviners and onmyoji arts?

999008199.text:
こりゃあ、すまない。そうだった。
外の国の方にはなじみのない職だ

localizations.en: Ah, my apologies. I should have explained. I forgot that those are not familiar concepts to those from other countries.

999008199.text:
百聞は一見に如かず、実際に披露しましょ。
こう見えて俺も陰陽師の端くれなのでね

localizations.en: Seeing is believing, so allow me to demonstrate. Despite how I look, I'm something of a diviner myself.
